# Synthetic bold

A medium-only family with no bold face: regular text.

**Synthetic bold**, *synthetic italic*, and ***synthetic bold italic***.

> Without the opt-in, the same family keeps its medium face for **bold text**.

## Real bold

This heading uses a family with a real bold face, so **bold text stays real**.

## CJK

中文字体没有粗体：简单、**合成粗体**、*合成斜体*、***合成粗斜体***。
